work.title: Sortie
work.description: Two oversized gold compact discs sit in concentric black-and-white halos in the upper register; below, a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane is centered on a blue bullseye. A frieze of small scoring targets runs along the base, with vertical orange and black bands dividing the field.
work.composition: two-register: paired discs above, plane-on-target below
